segments: A cry has gone out. Not a whisper, but a
roar. A sound has pierced the heavens
and has shook the earth. This is not a
call for the weak or for the
faint-hearted. Nah, this is for the
warriors, for the prophets of the most
high God. Answering a mission that has
been sealed in blood. We move not for
fame. Nah, not even for riches, but for
something more eternal. This mission is
holy. The cost is high. The risk are
real. We travel through dangerous
terrains, hostile lands, and uncertain
paths. We stand in the face of
opposition, persecution, and spiritual
warfare. We fear no man, for the Lord is
with us. From war torn neighborhoods to
distant deserts, from crowded city
streets to secluded mountain paths, the
prophets of God go anywhere where our
people are gathered. And we still press
forward. This is not just a journey.
This is war. This is war. Our banners
fly across the Caribbean, Bahamas,
Barbados, Biz, Grenada, Jamaica, Puerto
Rico, Trinidad, through the jungles and
highlands of South America, Ecuador,
Guyana, Peru, Sina, across the
unforgiving plains of Africa, Cameroon,
Ghana, Kenya, Liberia, Malawi, Nigeria,
Sierra Leon, South Africa, and Uganda
into the strongholds of Europe, France,
the Netherlands, London, across the
ancient lands of Asia. Carnotica, India,
to the southern reaches of Australia and
the icy winds of North America,
Montreal, Canada, even to the islands
scattered across the Pacific. We're
there. None of this would be possible
without the unwavering support of our
brothers and sisters who give to the
booster club. Your donations are not
just money. They're a fuel for the
mission, armor for the profits, wings
for the words to fly. You make it
possible through unity, through
sacrifice, through the spirit of Christ.
We move mountains. It's not just a
global movement. No, this is prophecy in
motion. Cuz the kingdom is rising. And
though the world resisted, the mission
will not be stopped. Why? Cuz we will
not be stopped. We are the warriors of
the most high God. And the world will
soon know we're here.
